Text.p: This qualification was first released in MSM Manufacturing Training Package Release 9.0.

Topic.PrintSuperHeading: MSM30325 Certificate III in Manufactured Mineral Products

Text.p: This qualification reflects the role of workers who perform a range of operations to directly produce manufactured mineral products for industry, including cement, precast concrete, pre-mixed concrete, quarry and asphalt.

The worker will be able to work independently and to apply theoretical and technical knowledge and well-developed skills to undertake operations and exercise judgement in areas such as start-up and shutdown procedures and quality assurance.

The worker will be able to apply product and process knowledge to anticipate and solve a range of routine and non-routine problems. This includes developing solutions to new problems which do not have a known or recorded solution in procedures.
There are 0 minimum work placement hours required for this unit.
No licensing, legislative or certification requirements apply to this qualification at the time of publication.
There are no entry requirements for this qualification.
at least 9 from the list below, with a maximum of 1 unit from Group A Measurements
up to 4 units from any endorsed Training Package or accredited course – these units must be relevant to the work outcome.
All electives chosen must contribute to a valid, industry-supported vocational outcome.

Any combination of electives that meets the rules above may be selected for the award of the Certificate III in Manufactured Mineral Products. Where appropriate, electives may be selected to achieve specialisations as follows:
for the award of MSM30325 Certificate III in Manufactured Mineral Products (precast concrete), at least 4 units must be selected from Group B.
Units with prerequisite requirements are marked with an asterisk.

td.p: Participate in environmentally sustainable work practices
Apply workplace context to own job
Meet compliance and quality requirements in precast concrete manufacture
Assemble, use and maintain moulds in precast concrete manufacture
Fabricate, assemble and place reinforcement in precast concrete products
Cast, finish and cure precast concrete products
Identify requirements for safe precast and tilt-up work
Cut and bend materials using oxy-LPG equipment
Licence to perform rigging basic level
Licence to perform rigging intermediate level
Lift and place prefabricated concrete elements
Patch prefabricated components of concrete elements
Work with products and materials containing crystalline silica
Apply WHS requirements, policies and procedures in the construction industry
Work safely and effectively in manufacturing and engineering
Use organisation computers or data systems
Set up and tune a process
Develop and adjust a production schedule
Facilitate the implementation of WHS for a work group
Licence to operate a slewing mobile crane (up to 60 tonnes)
Licence to operate a non-slewing mobile crane (greater than 3 tonnes capacity)
